text:
Incident Bot: Proposed alert change: reduce sensitivity on "tokenizer-error" alert from 0.2% -> 0.5% over 5m for prod inference. Will only apply as TEMP override for the next 2h unless reverted. PR: https://git.internal/r/infra/alerts/452 (discussion below)

Asha K.: dropping in — why the change? are we seeing too many noisy pages?

Incident Bot: Correct. Over the last 90m we've had ~340 tokenizer-error pages, 80% are from an interop model variant that's being rolled out. Paging noise is masking real 5xx spikes. SLO risk: tokenization errors do not currently increment user-facing 5xx SLO but confuse responders.

Matt D.: I can be primary for this change for the next 2h (oncall until 17:30 PST). @Priya S. will you be secondary?

Priya S.: yep I can be secondary until 18:00 PST. couple asks: (1) need a short customer-impact statement; (2) document runbook pointer where to flip this back.

Jin L.: quick note from infra: the rule lives in `infra/alerts/prod-inference.yaml`. example CLI to update (one-liner):

```
rg alerts infra/alerts/prod-inference.yaml -n tokenization -q 'threshold: 0.2' && sed -i 's/threshold: 0.2/threshold: 0.5/' infra/alerts/prod-inference.yaml && ./scripts/deploy-alerts --namespace=prod
```

Please do not merge directly without a thumbs-up from both primary+secondary.

Asha K.: Customer impact note for support: this move only silences pages for tokenization classifier errors (internal preprocessing). End-user requests still succeed; measurable customer-facing 5xx remains unchanged. So communicate: "No user-visible outage expected; temporarily suppressing noisy tokenizer pages to focus on real errors." Can someone paste the query used to measure customer hits?

Matt D.: pasted the query results below (ran at 16:12 PST):

```
-- customers with >=1 tokenizer-error in last 90m
SELECT customer_id, count(*) as errors
FROM infra.logs
WHERE event = 'tokenizer_error' AND ts >= now() - interval '90 minutes'
GROUP BY customer_id
ORDER BY errors DESC
LIMIT 20;
-- result: 5 customers with >50 errors, 12 with 5-49, remainder <5
```

Priya S.: ok that's small but non-zero. action plan: (1) apply TEMP threshold bump to 0.5% for 2h, (2) monitor the 5xx rate and latency dashboards, (3) if 5xx rate increases by >0.1% absolute OR error budget burn exceeds 0.5% in that window, revert immediately and escalate. I'll add those checks to the incident board.

Asha K.: runbook refs: https://wiki.internal/r/redwood/runbooks/oncall-inference and specifically section "tokenizer cascade". tagging it here for quick access. Also add a log snippet pattern to watch: `tokenizer_error: model_variant=*`

Jin L.: FYI for whoever flips it: after merge run `./scripts/alertctl reload --env=prod` and verify via `curl -s https://monitoring.internal/api/alerts?name=tokenizer-error | jq .threshold` should show `0.5`.

Ops Bot: Reminder set: 60m before revert window (at 17:30 PST) to reassess.

Matt D.: going to open the PR but waiting for ack from Priya and Asha. putting a small checklist in PR description: primary, secondary, customer-impact, revert-criteria, runbook link.

Priya S.: acked. once merged I'm on watch. if anything changes tag `@oncall-secondary` and start bridge.

Asha K.: quick note about handoff coverage after this window: we've got an upcoming region maintenance tonight 02:00 UTC — not fully staffed in EMEA. Matt, can you coordinate with platform on backup coverage if the noise shifts to that region?

Matt D.: will ping platform and add a calendar block.

Incident Bot: Change proposal recorded. Thread will be auto-archived after 7 days. If threshold change is reverted, please update PR with `reverted: true` and the reason. Thanks. :thumbsup:
